analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 판독 지속. RSI는 과매도 구간 진입 후 소폭 반등했으나, MACD 히스토그램은 여전히 약세 구간에서 개선 없이 유지 중. ADX는 26.4로 뚜렷한 추세가 형성되었으나, -DI가 +DI보다 훨씬 높아 하락 압력이 우위. 5일간 변동률은 +3.35%, -3.44%, +1.32%, +2.05%, -8.20%로 변동성이 크며 방향성 부재. 스윙 지지선 82,500원, 저항선 95,680원 구간에서 횡보 가능성.
analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see read has now held for 3 straight sessions. RSI has slightly rebounded after entering oversold territory, but the MACD histogram remains in the bearish zone without improvement. ADX is at 26.4, indicating a clear trend, but -DI is significantly higher than +DI, showing bearish pressure dominance. The 5-day volatility (+3.35%, -3.44%, +1.32%, +2.05%, -8.20%) shows high fluctuation and lack of direction. Sideways movement is possible between the swing support at 82,500 KRW and resistance at 95,680 KRW.
